risk_note: RV2 by path (union module wiring; logging only). D10-1096 (split from B1-04zgc after three spec-test rounds; its r3 S1 is this task): union.module.ts logPddWarning logged every PddWarning with an event as 'pinduoduo goods price anomaly' with only event + method, so the Pinduoduo order_status 4 / 10 alerts would lose alert / platform / fail_reason. PddWarning gains the two order events (order_reason_sub_unmapped, pdd_invalid_with_commission) and optional alert, platform and fail_reason (union/infra/pdd/response.ts); logPddWarning logs order_reason_sub_unmapped as exactly {event, alert, platform: 'pdd', method: warning.type, fail_reason} and pdd_invalid_with_commission as exactly {event, alert, platform: 'pdd', method: warning.type}, each with its own message; PRICE_ANOMALY and unknown-error-code output unchanged; no order number, amount or user. No behaviour outside logging; independent of B1-04zgc (which rebases on it).

reviews.note: Codex money review (D10-1096 asks Codex first; effort medium) round 1 pass with no findings.
